limitations: This is a deterministic seed-0 fixed-checkpoint screening study, not a random perturbation sample.
Budgets 15, 29, and 58 are primary graded comparisons; budget 146 is a high-intensity stress test.
Equal absolute budgets imply different fractions of each available stratum; both graph and stratum fractions are reported.
All scenarios use one generated graph and one split.
No retraining, robustness, or stability conclusion is supported.
